# ABC (Australian Broadcasting Corporation)

> Australia's public broadcaster providing news, entertainment, education and emergency services across television, radio, streaming and digital platforms.

ABC.net.au is the primary digital hub for the Australian Broadcasting Corporation, offering live breaking news, on-demand streaming content, educational resources, and emergency alerts. The platform serves millions of Australians with news coverage, entertainment programming, and public service broadcasting across multiple channels and formats.

## News & Breaking Updates

- [ABC News & Headlines](https://www.abc.net.au): ABC News homepage with live breaking news, headlines and updates from Australia
- [Just In - ABC News](https://www.abc.net.au/news/justin): Live breaking news feed with top stories from Australia and worldwide
- [Politics - ABC News](https://www.abc.net.au/news/politics): Australian politics coverage, policy analysis and election news

## Streaming & On-Demand Content

- [ABC iview](https://iview.abc.net.au): ABC iview streaming platform for dramas, documentaries, news and on-demand content
- [ABC listen](https://www.abc.net.au/listen): ABC listen audio streaming platform for podcasts, radio and music content
- [ABC Television - TV Guide & EPG](https://www.abc.net.au/tv/epg): Complete TV guide and electronic program guide for ABC channels

## Education & Kids

- [ABC Education](https://www.abc.net.au/education): Curriculum-linked learning resources for primary and secondary students
- [ABC Kids](https://www.abc.net.au/abckids): ABC Kids preschool programs with games, activities and educational content

## Emergency & Public Services

- [ABC Emergency](https://www.abc.net.au/emergency): Emergency alerts, bushfire safety and disaster warnings for Australia

## Site Navigation & Services

- [More from your ABC](https://www.abc.net.au/more): Navigation hub and directory for ABC services, channels and content
- [About the ABC](https://www.abc.net.au/about): ABC organizational overview, history, governance and media centre
- [ABC Shop](https://www.abc.net.au/shop): ABC Shop for books, merchandise, music and commercial ABC products

## Optional - Policies & Compliance

- [ABC Editorial Policies](https://www.abc.net.au/edpols): ABC editorial policies, code of practice and content standards
- [ABC Accessibility Statement](https://www.abc.net.au/about/accessibility-statement/103700726): WCAG 2.2 compliance and accessibility statement for ABC websites
